test_cases.summary:
Verify Multiple rapid toggles handled safely
when the user clicks Freeze and Unfreeze rapidly
test_cases.description:
Feature: Freeze Mode Toggle
Scenario: Multiple rapid toggles handled safely
Given the user clicks Freeze and Unfreeze rapidly
When the actions are processed
Then the system should remain stable without errors
test_cases.acceptance:
The system should remain stable without errors
The behavior should be validated when the actions are processed.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Grid renders within 2 seconds for 200 items
when a dataset containing 200 images per page
test_cases.description:
Feature: Image Grid Rendering Performance
Scenario: Grid renders within 2 seconds for 200 items
Given a dataset containing 200 images per page
When the grid loads
Then the grid should render completely within 2 seconds
test_cases.acceptance:
The grid should render completely within 2 seconds
The behavior should be validated when the grid loads.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Pagination transition is seamless
when the grid is loaded with images
test_cases.description:
Feature: Image Grid Rendering Performance
Scenario: Pagination transition is seamless
Given the grid is loaded with images
When the user navigates to the next page
Then the transition should occur smoothly without noticeable lag
test_cases.acceptance:
The transition should occur smoothly without noticeable lag
The behavior should be validated when the user navigates to the next page.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Skeleton screen appears immediately
when the user navigates to a new page
test_cases.description:
Feature: Loading Skeleton Feedback
Scenario: Skeleton screen appears immediately
Given the user navigates to a new page
When the data is being fetched
Then loading skeletons should display instantly
test_cases.acceptance:
Loading skeletons should display instantly
The behavior should be validated when the data is being fetched.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Images load only when entering viewport
when the grid contains many images
test_cases.description:
Feature: Lazy Loading Optimization
Scenario: Images load only when entering viewport
Given the grid contains many images
When the user scrolls
Then images should load only when visible in the viewport
test_cases.acceptance:
Images should load only when visible in the viewport
The behavior should be validated when the user scrolls.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Compressed thumbnails reduce bandwidth
when the grid loads thumbnails
test_cases.description:
Feature: Thumbnail Compression
Scenario: Compressed thumbnails reduce bandwidth
Given the grid loads thumbnails
When images are requested from server
Then compressed JPEG thumbnails should be delivered
test_cases.acceptance:
Compressed JPEG thumbnails should be delivered
The behavior should be validated when images are requested from server.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Efficient DOM diffing prevents flicker
when the grid updates state
test_cases.description:
Feature: Stable Re-rendering
Scenario: Efficient DOM diffing prevents flicker
Given the grid updates state
When images refresh
Then UI should not flicker or re-render unnecessarily
test_cases.acceptance:
UI should not flicker or re-render unnecessarily
The behavior should be validated when images refresh.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Items per page update quickly
when the user changes page size to 200
test_cases.description:
Feature: Fast Page Size Change
Scenario: Items per page update quickly
Given the user changes page size to 200
When the grid refreshes
Then updated results should render within 2 seconds
test_cases.acceptance:
Updated results should render within 2 seconds
The behavior should be validated when the grid refreshes.

test_cases.summary:
Verify System handles continuous page navigation
when the user navigates pages repeatedly

Feature: High Volume Stability
Scenario: System handles continuous page navigation
Given the user navigates pages repeatedly
When switching 10+ times rapidly
Then the system should remain responsive without crashes
test_cases.acceptance:
The system should remain responsive without crashes
The behavior should be validated when switching 10+ times rapidly.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Smooth scrolling across grid
when many images are displayed
test_cases.description:
Feature: Scroll Performance
Scenario: Smooth scrolling across grid
Given many images are displayed
When the user scrolls quickly

test_cases.acceptance:
Scrolling should remain smooth (~60fps)

test_cases.summary:
Verify Slow connection alert displayed

Feature: Slow Network Warning

test_cases.acceptance:
A 'Connection Slow' warning toast should appear
The behavior should be validated when data fetch is delayed.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Retry after slow network
when the connection slow warning is shown

Feature: Retry Fetch Capability
Scenario: Retry after slow network
Given the connection slow warning is shown
When the user clicks retry
Then the grid should reload successfully
test_cases.acceptance:
The grid should reload successfully
The behavior should be validated when the user clicks retry.

test_cases.summary:

Scenario: Continuous workflow without blocking
Given the user performs labeling or navigation

test_cases.acceptance:
Actions should not block the workflow

test_cases.summary:

when the user is authenticated

Given the user is authenticated

test_cases.acceptance:
The header should display 'Logged in as: [username]'
The behavior should be validated when the grid page loads.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Label button enabled for authorized role
when user.permissions.canLabel = true
test_cases.description:
Feature: Role-Based Access Control – Label Permission
Scenario: Label button enabled for authorized role
Given user.permissions.canLabel = true
When images are selected
Then the APPLY button should be enabled
test_cases.acceptance:
The APPLY button should be enabled
The behavior should be validated when images are selected.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Label button disabled for read-only role
when user.permissions.canLabel = false
test_cases.description:
Feature: Role-Based Access Control – Label Restriction
Scenario: Label button disabled for read-only role
Given user.permissions.canLabel = false
When the page loads

test_cases.acceptance:
The APPLY button should be hidden or disabled
The behavior should be validated when the page loads.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Send for QC enabled for authorized users
when user has QC permission
test_cases.description:
Feature: Role-Based Access Control – Send for QC Permission
Scenario: Send for QC enabled for authorized users
Given user has QC permission
When images are selected
Then the Send for QC button should be clickable
test_cases.acceptance:
The Send for QC button should be clickable
The behavior should be validated when images are selected.

test_cases.summary:

Feature: Role-Based Access Control – Send for QC Restriction
Scenario: Send for QC hidden for read-only users

test_cases.acceptance:

test_cases.summary:

test_cases.description:
Feature: Role-Based Access Control – Backend Enforcement
Scenario: Unauthorized API action blocked
Given read-only user triggers label API

test_cases.acceptance:
API should return 403/401 and action should fail
The behavior should be validated when request is sent.

test_cases.summary:

Scenario: Session expires during action
Given session timeout occurs

The behavior should be validated when user performs any API action.

test_cases.summary:

test_cases.summary:

Scenario: User permissions stored in session state

test_cases.acceptance:

The behavior should be validated when session is inspected.

test_cases.acceptance:
